decisive_items: CD20+, Pax5+, BcL-2+, BcL-6+, CD10−, mum-1+, Cmyc+ (40%)
response.rationale: Splenic biopsy immunophenotype (CD20+, Pax5+, Bcl-2+, Bcl-6+, MUM1+, C-myc 40%, Ki67 80%) is diagnostic of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. R2 is a broader etiologic association (HIV) but not the specific diagnosis; R3 is a non-specific descriptive category.

rejected.why: Too broad; merely describes splenomegaly with lymphoproliferation without specifying the lymphoma subtype.
HIV is a risk factor, but the biopsy findings directly establish DLBCL, making this less specific.
